the dropped-document reporting c816996eb3 adds -- iter_resources(..., ignore_invalid=True) inside resource_scan_scope plus the (str(Path(docs)), project) lookup into the scope's record -- has no test, so a regression in that key shape or in the tolerant flag would silently return an empty failed list and the pass would stop naming the document whose location conflicts with its type, which is the whole point of the replacement; the only exercise of it is the worker's live dry run (head-arm.log, nova failed=8).
